facts.fact: The Nouakchott Data Centre (Centre de Donnees de Nouakchott), a state facility of 1,372 sq m and 100 racks, was inaugurated by the President on 2025-05-08, marking the start of operation, offering in-country cloud hosting, backup and disaster recovery to public administrations, financial institutions, startups and service providers (AMI).

AMI states the Nouakchott Data Centre, in service from its 2025-05-08 inauguration, holds a Level 3 (Tier III) certification (attributed to an 'AppTime Global Institute', apparently the Uptime Institute) with availability above 99.982 percent.
